text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"This 'bookstore' has an 'extensive' 
collection of 'specialized books'... Then 
surely, 'Fundamentals of Aerospace 
Engineering & Orbital Design' should 
also—"

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry, that book is currently out 
of stock. It's out of print, so we're 
unable to backorder it either—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The book she wanted was out of print, 
leaving Neo Universe feeling 
disheartened...
